units.source_text: 此后数日之内，宫中上下，皆以品评须磨画卷为事。

en.t: For several days after that, everyone in the palace, high and low, was occupied with judging and discussing the Suma picture scrolls.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣说：“这须磨画卷请留存在母后处。”

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, said, “Please leave these Suma picture scrolls in the Empress Mother’s care.”

units.source_text: 藤壶母后也很想从头至尾细看这画卷，便接受了，回答说：“让我慢慢地欣赏。”

en.t: The Empress Mother Fujitsubo also wished to examine the scrolls carefully from beginning to end, so she accepted them and replied, “Let me enjoy them at my leisure.”

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣看见冷泉帝对这次赛画感到十分满意，心中非常欢喜。

en.t: Seeing that Emperor Reizei was thoroughly pleased with this picture contest, Genji, the Inner Minister, was very happy at heart.

units.source_text: 权中纳言看见源氏内大臣在赛画这些小事情上也如此袒护梅壶女御，深恐自己的女儿弘徽殿女御失宠，不免担心。

en.t: When the Acting Middle Counselor saw that Genji, the Inner Minister, protected the Umetsubo Consort even in such minor matters as the picture contest, he deeply feared that his own daughter, the Kokiden Consort, would lose the Emperor’s favor, and could not help worrying.

units.source_text: 但念皇上一向亲近弘徽殿，又窥察情况，看见皇上对她还是顾念周至，便觉得即使源氏袒护梅壶，也不怕了。

en.t: But remembering that the Emperor had always been close to Kokiden, and observing the situation further, he saw that the Emperor still showed her careful consideration, and so felt that even if Genji protected Umetsubo, there was no need to be afraid.
